content.short: GeckoTerminal is a DEX market tracker for token prices, pools, volume, and liquidity across TON and other chains.
content.description: GeckoTerminal provides real-time statistics and price analysis across multiple blockchains and decentralized exchanges, consolidating market data into a single view. Users can identify trends as they emerge and access up-to-date statistics on tokens and pools across diverse networks. The platform also presents Proof of Reserves data, enabling users to monitor centralized exchanges' on-chain holdings and assess reserve transparency directly on the blockchain. GeckoTerminal supports DeFi workflows that would otherwise require users to jump between explorers, bridges, dashboards, or routers.
content.meta: GeckoTerminal is a DEX data tracker and price charting tool by CoinGecko. Discover its TON DeFi tooling role and related infrastructure on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
